personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 4 Tactile / Playful gamification structure
personality_one_liner: A high-octane, dark-mode command center that tracks your guitar mastery with the addictive, chunky rewards of a gamified hit.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing around gamified tactile cards. Keep top sticky headers and bottom CTA thumb-zones clear.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar to allow lessons/paths to scroll underneath
Use heavy tint + blur on the live Studio camera overlay (70% opacity #121212 tint over the blur)
dont's: Don't blur dense lesson list cards or form fields
Don't use glass without at least 75% dark tint backing to preserve contrast

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Gamified dashboard showing 'My Path', persistent streak/XP top header, and AI Riff chat launch.

states.error: Failed to load progress. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky top header with Duolingo-style streak flame and XP counters. Vertical winding path of circular nodes (gold for complete, pulsing for active). A floating 'Ask Riff' FAB for AI chat.

screens.name: Studio
screens.purpose: Live practice environment with camera overlay, pitch meter, and MIDI tracking.

states.empty: Connect MIDI or allow camera access

screens.layout: Full-bleed camera feed background with a heavy 80% surface glass scrim. Live pitch meter (condensed bold typography), animated waveform, and massive primary 'Start Session' CTA sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Lessons
screens.purpose: Structured library of guitar courses and riffs with difficulty badges.

states.empty: No lessons found for this filter.

screens.layout: Vertical list of thick, tactile cards (surfaceSecondary). Each card has a real guitar photo hero image (with top-to-bottom gradient scrim), progress bar, and difficulty pill badge. Grid spacing.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Long-term stats hub showing streak calendars, XP rings, and achievement badges.

states.empty: Complete your first lesson to earn badges

screens.layout: Profile header with avatar. Large tactile widgets for Total XP, Streak Calendar heatmap, and a grid of unlocked golden pick badges.

lesson_electric.alt: Electric guitar fretboard playing dark moody

lesson_acoustic.alt: Acoustic guitar sitting on a stand empty dark stage

ai_avatar_badge.alt: Copper guitar pick badge for AI avatar or streak achievement

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a custom 'Duolingo meets Fender Play' gamified layout. This means chunky, tactile UI components (Tactile/Playful structure) combined with a highly legible Dark-First Utility color palette (#121212 base with Signal Orange #FF6B00 accents).
Zero tolerance for blue, indigo, or purple. Stick strictly to the dark/orange/copper palette to maintain the music-industry/amplifier aesthetic.
Implement a persistent sticky header on the Home dashboard tracking current Streaks and XP (reference Duolingo's top bar layout), while maintaining a dark, moody background.

For the Studio screen, use a full-screen layout. If displaying camera/video beneath, heavily tint the scrim (min 70% opacity on #121212) to ensure the live pitch meter and metrics remain WCAG AAA readable.
Cards in the Lessons tab must feature real background photography. You MUST use the gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) overlaid on these images so text pops cleanly.
Gamify the interactions: wire up haptic feedback on successes (streaks, completing a module) and use large, touchable hit areas (min 44x44pt).
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for high-impact metrics (Live Pitch, XP count, Level), and Satoshi for all body/reading text. Do not exceed font weight 500.
